response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT CASE WHEN c.state = '' OR c.state IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE c.state END as state, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM player_college pc INNER JOIN college c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.state = '' OR c.state IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE c.state END), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM matched) SELECT matched.state, matched.cnt as count, matched.cnt * 1.0 / total.total_cnt as share FROM matched, total ORDER BY matched.state NULLS LAST;

assumptions.assumption: Blank or missing states (NULL values and empty strings) are grouped together into a single group representing all blank/missing values

alternatives.interpretation: Blank or missing states should be treated as separate groups—NULL distinct from empty string—rather than combined
